inherits: live-plan-b3-v1 environment ranking and Plan B qualification gates
hard_requirements: Candidate appears in the possible home XI for the provisional board.
Candidate must later appear in the confirmed home starting XI before kickoff.
Candidate remains one of the top two eligible confirmed home shooters.
Candidate has at least four 2+ shot hits in the previous five starts.
Candidate averages at least 3.0 shots and 80 minutes across the previous five starts.

consistency_rule.procedure: Start with the highest remaining average-shots candidate and group all remaining candidates within 0.5 shots of that anchor.
within_similar_group_order: minimum shots across previous five starts descending
population standard deviation of shots across previous five starts ascending
average player share of team shots descending

replacement_policy: Never promote a lower-ranked replacement after the provisional board is frozen.
